parts.display_text: Calculate the maximum current due to these electrons in the detector chamber.

answer.text: I = (5.08 × 10⁹ s⁻¹)(1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ C) = 8.13 × 10⁻¹⁰ A, or approximately 0.81 nA.
